notes.title: [Just Squat] Demo Patch 0.1
notes.content:
Considering the difficulty level after the demo version, all accessary exercise values ​​have been adjusted.

Cable Raise: Adjusted the bullet start angle and location, reduced the number of bullets
Dumbbell Raise: Adjusted the bullet circumference and rotation speed
Kettlebell Raise: Adjusted the number of bullets
Dumbbell Press: Reduced the limit for maintaining maximum bullets
Bench Press: Slightly increased bullet speed, slightly increased cooldown
Calf Raise: Slightly reduced bullet speed
Lunge: Changed bullet firing from 2 to 1
Leg Press: Increased the number of bullets emitted
Deadlift: Increased the number of bullets emitted and changed the path randomly each time they were emitted.

Thank you.
